steps.note: Open an existing event whose technical stage is closed and has a vendor response awaiting evaluator scoring.
Navigate to the technical stage where the selected Evaluation Matrix section and its questions are scored.
Assign scores to the vendor's technical responses and submit the evaluation.

args.goal: on the evaluator's technical scoring screen, verify that one selected Evaluation Matrix section shows a top section total equal to the sum of all question scores entered in that section; stop when the section total and its contributing question scores are visible

steps.note: Observe the section-level auto-sum and compare it with the individual question scores.
Confirm that the evaluation screen completed without an application error.
